teaser: You lock the platform down: permission modes, a human-approval callback, injection defences and a sandbox so one bad prompt cannot wreck prod.
takeaways: Permission layers run in order: hooks → deny rules → ask rules → permission mode → allow rules → can_use_tool callback. Deny always wins.
Modes: default, acceptEdits, plan, dontAsk, bypassPermissions (sandboxes only), auto. allowed_tools does not restrict bypassPermissions.
can_use_tool returns PermissionResultAllow or PermissionResultDeny(message=...); modes are coarse static policy, callbacks per-call logic.
Treat tool output as data: limit tools after untrusted content, require approval for side effects, cap spend with max_budget_usd.
